title: ValueStream demos
headline: Walk into a working practice.
lede: Each demo is a complete, running copy of the product - a made-up practice with its clients and matters, work in progress and a team at work. Sign in with a code sent to your email and you join it as a senior member. Open files, change numbers, record the day's work. Nothing you do can break it.
clock_note: Every night the demos are put back to their clean sample data. Anything you added or changed is wiped then - so explore freely.
clock_now: Being reset right now - back in a minute.
steps: Your name and email. A 6-digit code reaches your inbox - no password, no card.
You join the demo practice as a senior member, with real-looking clients, matters and work under way.
Do the day's work - file a return, record a hearing. The practice is yours until tonight's reset.

products.name: SimplyFy
products.kind: Tax filing and audit for CA firms - and your own return
products.about: From a client's Excel to a return ready to file - for a whole practice, or for one person with their own documents.
points: Statements mapped to ITR-3 / ITR-5 and Form 3CD; 26AS / AIS / TIS reconciled
My return: ITR-1 to ITR-4 for individuals and HUFs, read from their own Form 16, AIS and statements
Tax rules: each year's slabs, caps and due dates compared and applied
Tax audit and GST checks, History of every change, a team with roles
New filing: pick who - a person, an HUF, a firm, an LLP, an AOP or a company - and drop the documents in; 15 worked examples, each with its film

products.name: JustyFy
products.about: Every matter of every case type, tomorrow's board, one step after each hearing, and a limitation diary that never forgets.
points: Seventy-two civil and criminal case types - BNS and IPC side by side
Tomorrow's board by court and hall
One step after a hearing: next date, tasks, fee, client update
Appeal, revision and default-bail clocks with copy time left out
Law updates: court holidays and time limits checked and applied once - every deadline follows

products.name: DummyFy
products.about: Make test data from nothing, or make a real file safe - and watch your upload deleted from the server.
points: Every column recognised with a confidence; links between files found
46 identifiers from 6 countries - Aadhaar, PAN, SSN, IBAN - valid check digits
The same customer becomes the same new customer in every file: zero orphans
Show server folder, then Yes, delete - the server lists it empty

products.name: HealthyFy
products.kind: Clinic software - the calm clinic day
products.about: Patients with consent, the queue and tokens, a prescription the rules check before it is signed, reports, bills and the day's close.
points: Consent under the DPDP Act recorded for every patient, with date and purpose
Vitals flagged against the clinic's ranges, each with its reason
Allergy, daily maximum, child's weight and same-class checks stop a dose
The health record in one click; the day closes by itself

products.name: TradyFy
products.kind: Equity research for NSE and BSE small and mid caps
products.about: Every number traced to the exchange's own file: red flags from the filings, a valuation band of the company's own year, sector peers and a watchlist. A research tool, not investment advice.
points: 25 worked cases over invented companies, each with a step-by-step walk
Red flags: pledge, promoter holding, auditor, related parties, cash conversion, leverage
Valuation band, dividends, bonus and split on one timeline; sector peers side by side
Click any number to see the file it came from; results day run live

products.name: ValueFy
products.about: The store for ValueStream's Android apps: what each one does, its latest version and an Install button. Nothing to sign up for - open it on an Android phone.
points: Each app's page: its features, its latest version and what changed
Install straight from the page - the APK, checked and kept by version
An iPhone is told 'coming soon'; a computer gets the address to open on the phone
The owner sees visitors, page views and downloads by app and version

trust: No real client's information is in these demos - every name, PAN and figure is made up.
Your changes last until the nightly reset, then the firm starts fresh for the next visitor.
We use it only to send your sign-in code and to know who visited.

deck.title: ValueStream in ten minutes
deck.about: A narrated walk through the whole family - the five portals, the foundation they share, Chip Chat and how the demos work. Plays in your browser, and works offline once saved.
